acceptanceCriteria: The trusted pins are set so the `corvint test` shadow step runs on pull requests, and its dry-run plans are retained per shard.
AFP-V0-029 shadow rows in forward epoch 1 meet the bar, retained in a build-log entry with every plan difference against `tools/corvint-pr-tests` explained.

The CI go-product-shard execution call site uses `corvint test` instead of `tools/corvint-pr-tests`, with owner AFP-V0-016 consent on the head SHA, and the spec's Rollout section marks step 3 promoted.
body: Split from V1-0040 at its closeout (owner choice, 2026-10-12). PR beamfall/corvint#815 (merge 1f75ce55277da29fae385d5183940dd7ec2fd10f) delivered STR-V0-012 rollout step 3 only as a shadow: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` go-product-shard runs `corvint test --dry-run --profile ci --placement universe` beside `tools/corvint-pr-tests`, and `CORVINT_PR_FORWARD_EPOCH` is 1 (AFP-V0-030), but the step is inactive while the trusted pins (`CORVINT_PR_TOOL_SOURCE`) are empty, so the AFP-V0-029 shadow bar has zero rows and the driver still decides and executes. Decision 0526 keeps the AFP-V0-029 bar as a precondition for any CI narrowing. This ticket owns the remainder: activate the shadow, accumulate and retain the bar's rows in epoch 1, then switch the CI execution call site to `corvint test` behind owner AFP-V0-016 consent. Rollback: docs/specs/session-test-runner-v0.md, Rollout and rollback (restore `tools/corvint-pr-tests`; `CORVINT_PR_NARROWING=off`).
title: CI cutover: `corvint test` replaces `tools/corvint-pr-tests` after the AFP-V0-029 shadow bar (STR-V0-012 step 3 remainder)
